roadmap.title: Opening missions and quick unlocks
roadmap.description: Play the first missions while grabbing the easy early unlocks: food, clothing, fish kill, first cockfight bet and early stat awards.

roadmap.title: Mid story and stat awards
roadmap.description: Continue the story to Initiation, hijack and shoot out cop tires, start events and collect melee weapons while stat awards climb.

roadmap.title: Late story and district sweeps
roadmap.description: Finish Dockyard Heist, sweep shrines, cameras, karaoke, martial arts clubs, Roland trucks, and the high-stakes cockfight.

roadmap.title: Cleanup and 100% completion
roadmap.description: Finish Big Smile Lee, then clear cases, favors, events, races, lockboxes, shopping and the remaining stat awards.

roadmap.title: Nightmare in North Point
roadmap.description: Play the DLC story from the main menu; grind Jiang Shi and Yaoguai stats and find the ten Hell Shrines.

roadmap.title: Year of the Snake
roadmap.description: Play the DLC story from the main menu, finish the secondary content and find the 20 evidence bags.

achievements.summary: Finish the story mission Night Market Chase.

steps.text: Play @loc{Night Market Chase}, the second main mission, to the end.
Play @loc{Payback}, the ninth main mission, to the end.

achievements.summary: Finish the story mission Dockyard Heist.

steps.text: Play @loc{Dockyard Heist}, the eighteenth main mission, to the end.

achievements.summary: Finish the story mission Big Smile Lee.

steps.text: Play @loc{Big Smile Lee}, the last main mission of the base game, to the end.
Earn Face experience by beating enemies and finishing Favors, Races and Martial Arts fights.
Keep finishing Favors, Races, Martial Arts fights and main missions.
Wear Face clothing sets and accessories to earn Face experience faster.

guide.context: Face level 10 usually arrives around the mission Initiation. It also gives 40% off all vehicles.

steps.text: Keep finishing Favors, Races, Martial Arts fights and main missions.
Wear a Face clothing set to earn extra Face experience.

achievements.description: Change all your clothes in your wardrobe or a clothing store.
achievements.summary: Change every clothing slot at a wardrobe or clothing store.

steps.text: Open your apartment wardrobe or a clothing store and swap one item in every slot. The slots are hat, eyes, necklace, torso, pants, both arms and shoes.

guide.context: The story also forces an action hijack in Payback.

steps.text: Drive near another moving vehicle and hold @mechanic{A} until the arrow turns green.
Press @mechanic{A} again to jump into the other vehicle.

achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with a fish.

steps.text: In @loc{Club Bam Bam}, on the second-floor fight, grab an enemy and trigger the environmental kill on the aquarium along the right wall.
Pick up the fish that drops and hit enemies with it until one dies.
The aquarium on the left side drops no fish. A later fish market mission also has fish.

achievements.displayName: Take A Bite Out Of Crime

steps.text: Start the Popstar case from the blue shield icon and finish its last lead during @loc{Mini Bus Racket}.

achievements.description: Visit Aberdeen, Central, Kennedy Town and North Point.
achievements.summary: Enter all four districts: North Point, Central, Aberdeen and Kennedy Town.

steps.text: Story missions take you to all four districts. If one is missing, drive there.

guide.context: Any ten different items count. Spicy Squid is the hardest to find.

steps.text: Buy from street stalls: Dragon Kick, Herbal Tea, Pork Bun, Noodle Bowl, Fish Dumpling Skewer, Ice Cream, Roasted Duck, Curry Fish Balls and Chicken on a Stick.
Buy Spicy Squid from a stall on the Aberdeen promenade on the Hong Kong side.
Grab an enemy and look for objects that flash red, such as garbage bins, telephone booths, fans and electric panels.
Stand near one and press the action button to kill with it. Use five different kinds.

achievements.description: Pick a lock, plant a bug, trace a phone, crack a safe, and take over a spy camera.
achievements.sortReason: Gadget tasks finish by The Wedding.
achievements.summary: Complete five spy tasks: lockpicking, bugging, phone tracing, safe cracking and spy camera takeover.

steps.text: Play the story through @loc{The Wedding}. These tasks all come up in main missions, including the bug and lockpick in @loc{Listening In}.

achievements.description: Cruise for 2 minutes over 60 Km/h without damaging your car.
achievements.summary: Drive for 2 minutes in a row without damaging the car.

guide.context: Bikes do not count.

steps.text: Take a class C or D car onto an open highway.
Drive carefully for 2 minutes. Any damage restarts the timer.

achievements.description: Use 10 different firearms to defeat enemies.

steps.text: Pick up each new gun and kill someone with it. Check Statistics, then All Statistics, for the guns you have used.

Guns: 9mm Pistol from Payback or a lockbox; .45cal Pistol with Taclight; Machine Pistol from cops at heat 3 or higher; .45cal SMG; .45cal SMG with Taclight from The Wedding; Pump Shotgun from cop car trunks; Anti-Riot Shotgun from Civil Discord; Assault Rifle from The Funeral; Assault Rifle with Taclight from The Wedding; Assault Rifle with Grenade Launcher from The Funeral.

achievements.description: Use 10 different melee weapons to defeat enemies.
achievements.summary: Defeat enemies with 10 different melee weapons.

steps.text: Pick up each new melee weapon and kill someone with it.

Common ones: Tire Iron and Crowbar from car trunks; Knife and Kitchen Knife from enemies; Briefcase, Handbag and Umbrella from pedestrians; Fish in Club Bam Bam; Sauce Pan in Vendor Extortion; Hand Grinder in Dockyard Heist; Machete in The Election; Meat Cleaver and Baton from Drug Busts.

achievements.description: Win a bet on a cockfight.
achievements.summary: Win a bet on a cockfight.

steps.text: Go to the North Point cockfight and bet the low stake of 500 on a rooster.
Try again if you lose.

guide.context: The outcome is luck.

steps.text: Save your game, then go to the Kennedy Docks cockfight.
Bet 50,000 on a rooster. If you lose, reload your save and bet again.

achievements.description: Hijack 5 trucks and collect their cargo.
achievements.summary: Hijack 5 armored Knox trucks and deliver their cargo.

steps.text: After Roland Ho calls with the job, look for blue armored trucks with an orange shield above them.
Perform an action hijack on a truck, lose the cops, then drive it to the garage. Do this five times.

achievements.description: Shoot out a cop's tires while fleeing in a police chase.
achievements.sortReason: Shoot a cop tire during a chase.
achievements.summary: Shoot out a cop car tire while fleeing a police chase.

guide.context: Some story missions, such as Intensive Care, also give a chance.

steps.text: Start a chase by running a cop car over or stealing a car in front of one.
While the cops chase you, shoot a cop car tire.

guide.context: The cases open during Night Market Chase, Meet Winston, Loose Ends and The Funeral.

steps.text: Finish every lead of the Popstar, Hotshot, Serial Killer and Kidnapper cases. They show as blue shield icons.

guide.context: Some Favors open only after story progress.

steps.text: Do every Favor. Each shows on the map as a yellow bubble with a person icon. Dates count as Favors.
Do Drunk Disposal last if needed; you need a boat to reach it on the coast south of North Point.

achievements.description: Complete half of the open world events.

guide.context: Events do not appear in rain or at night. Sleep at home to skip them.

steps.text: Drive around in daytime and clear weather. Finish Drug Busts first because they show on the map.

achievements.description: Complete all of the open world Events.

guide.context: Only Drug Busts are marked on the map. Other events show up when you walk or drive close.

steps.text: Finish 17 Drug Busts, 4 Shoplifters (loitering), 3 Hit and Runs and 4 Junk in the Trunk events.
Check Menu, Statistics, Stats, Completion for 28/28. Search for missing events in daytime and clear weather.

guide.context: Drink Dragon Kick before each fight.

steps.text: Visit the Kung Fu Temple to open the clubs, then beat the clubs in North Point, Central, Aberdeen and Kennedy Town.
Win six waves of enemies at each club. Counter attacks, and press @mechanic{E} to escape big enemies that grab you.
Buy a class A car and bike, plus fast class B and C ones.
Win every street race, including the 3 extra races from the Street Racer Pack.
Slow down for corners. Opponents are slow in corners, so you can catch them there.
Earn Triad experience from main missions. Wear Triad clothing sets before each story mission.
If you are short at the end, replay the mission The Election or Mrs. Chu's Revenge.

guide.context: This usually comes around Dockyard Heist.

steps.text: Earn Cop experience in cases, cop jobs and missions. Do not kill innocents or damage property.

achievements.description: Unlock every lockbox in North Point.
achievements.summary: Open every lockbox in North Point.

steps.text: Open all 40 lockboxes in North Point. Some can only be reached by water, so take them once you have a boat.
After you date Ilyana, the map marks every lockbox. Collected ones turn white and missing ones turn grey.
Open all 30 lockboxes in Central, including the one near Victoria Peak.
After you date Ilyana, the map marks every lockbox. Collected ones turn white and missing ones turn grey.

achievements.description: Unlock every lockbox in Kennedy Town and Aberdeen.
achievements.summary: Unlock all lockboxes in the Kennedy Town and Aberdeen districts.

steps.text: Open all 15 lockboxes in Kennedy Town and all 15 in Aberdeen.
The Aberdeen one on a roof near the pier: climb the green dumpster at the fence door. The Kennedy Town one on a container at the docks: use the ocean-side road, then climb up.
After you date Ilyana, the map marks every lockbox.

achievements.summary: Finish all 5 of Roland's debt collecting jobs.

steps.text: After Payback, call Roland on the phone for each job: Samson Gao, Norbert Yang, Terrence, Tommy Wu and Samson Sequel.

achievements.description: Achieving 90% and above for all songs at the Karaoke Bars in HK.
achievements.summary: Score 90% or higher on all 8 karaoke songs.

guide.context: Steer the cursor up or down to match the lyrics line. On keyboard, hold Shift with the arrows to reach the edges. Real Men Don't Karaoke needs a low score, so sing the new songs well afterward.

collectibles.name: I Fought The Law
collectibles.method: Sing it in the first karaoke visit.

collectibles.name: All Out of Love
collectibles.method: Opens in the early story, around the date with Tiffany.

collectibles.name: Reeling In The Years
collectibles.method: Opens in the early story, around the date with Tiffany.

collectibles.name: Hit Me With Your Best Shot
collectibles.method: Opens in the early story, around the date with Tiffany.

collectibles.name: Bad Case of Lovin' You
collectibles.method: Sing it in the story mission that includes karaoke.

collectibles.name: I Ran (So Far Away)
collectibles.method: Opens when you start the favor Real Men Don't Karaoke.

collectibles.name: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun
collectibles.method: Opens when you start the favor Real Men Don't Karaoke.

collectibles.name: Take On Me
collectibles.method: Opens after you finish Real Men Don't Karaoke.

achievements.description: Hack every Security Camera in the game.

guide.context: You can still hack a camera missed in Listening In later, on foot.

steps.text: Hack cameras that open after Drug Busts, then date Not Ping to show the rest on the map.
If you cannot find a hacking panel, follow the orange cable from the camera.

guide.context: Clothes from lockboxes do not count.

steps.text: Visit every clothing store and buy every item, including the legendary clothes shop.
Buy Face and Triad bonus sets first. Wait for the 40% discount at Face level 10 for the pricey legendary items.

achievements.description: Pray at all of the Health Shrines.

steps.text: Date Amanda until the map shows health shrines. Press @mechanic{Q} to view collectibles.
Pray at each red, flashing statue. Collected ones turn white and missing ones turn grey.

achievements.sortReason: Buy all vehicles late for discounts.

steps.text: Wear the master negotiator set from the Kennedy Town clothing shop for 15% off after you reach Face level 10.
Buy every car and bike in the shops: one in Kennedy Town, two in North Point and one in Central.
Open the pause menu, Social Hub, Stat Awards. Raise easy stats such as Defence, Martial Artist, Enforcer and Mogul.
Keep raising stats from the Stat Awards menu. Most come with normal play.
Keep raising stats. The Zodiac Tournament event adds two extra stats to help.
Raise an easy stat to gold, usually Defence or Martial Artist.
Keep raising the easiest stats to gold.
Keep raising stats to gold. Defence, Martial Artist, Enforcer and Mogul rise with normal play.

guide.context: Gold requirements: Total Stat Awards 75; Head Hunter 50 headshots; Lucky Shooter 10 blind-fire kills; Sniper 50% accuracy; Gunman 100 firearm kills; Environmentalist 50; Handyman 50; Defence 100 counters; Fast Talker 10; Martial Artist 100; Enforcer 200; Safe Driver 30 minutes; Hijacker 20; Racer 17; Mogul 2,000,000; Big Spender 2,000,000; Completionist 100%; Explorer 175 collectibles; Survivor 20 minutes; Public Enemy 200 kills in one session. The counter can lag; finishing other tasks makes a delayed unlock appear.

steps.text: Open Social Hub, Stat Awards and push every stat to gold. 32 exist; you need 30.
Fluid Striker and Disarming: replay Mrs. Chu's Revenge and vault over cover into armed enemies in the garage chase.
Fire Starter and Wrecker: replay The Funeral. Take the grenade launcher and fire at the cars in the parking lot.
Bonebreaker and Ninja need Leg Breaker: grab an enemy, tap attack once, then hold. Then sneak behind a stunned enemy for a sneak kill.
Deadeye: throw Tire Irons from car trunks with the throw button.
Public Enemy: get the kill total in one play session, using the wave-fight event named Death by a Thousand Cuts or a long run of missions. Dying does not reset it.
Gambler: save, bet 100,000 at the Kennedy Town cockfight, and reload on a loss.
Survivor and Rogue Cop: get heat level 2 and let cops chase you.

The Zodiac Tournament event adds two extra stats, Smashing Success and Statuesque. Getting both lets you skip Gambler. For Smashing Success, throw enemies into the fire in the fight named Trial by Fire.

achievements.description: Complete 10% of all missions, cases, favors, events, jobs and races.

steps.text: Keep playing story and side content, then read the Completion page in Statistics to see your percentage.

achievements.description: Complete 25% of all missions, cases, favors, events, jobs and races.

steps.text: Play on and complete more story missions and side activities.

achievements.description: Complete 50% of all missions, cases, favors, events, jobs and races.

steps.text: Play on and complete more story missions and side activities.

achievements.description: Complete 100% of all missions, cases, favors, events, jobs and races.
achievements.sortReason: 100% completion needs everything including Wheels of Fury.

guide.context: Wheels of Fury jobs count toward completion. Skipping them leaves you stuck near 97%.

steps.text: Complete every story mission and side activity, including Tran's car jobs and the Wheels of Fury Cruise and Derby jobs in all four districts.
Check Statistics, Completion for what is still missing.

achievements.description: Send Dogeyes, Ratface and Ponytail back to Hell.
achievements.summary: Finish the Nightmare in North Point mission Ghosts of the Past.

guide.context: The Peachwood Sword makes the final fight easier. Carry one in.

steps.text: Start the DLC from the main menu. Finish @loc{Ghosts of the Past}, the sixth DLC mission.
Defeat Dogeyes, Ratface and Ponytail.

achievements.summary: Finish the Nightmare in North Point mission Smiley Cat.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Smiley Cat}, the last DLC mission.
Finish the Vampire Hunter stat before this mission if you want it; the mission ends the story.

achievements.description: Complete all secondary content of Nightmare in North Point.
achievements.summary: Finish all secondary content in Nightmare in North Point.

steps.text: Finish every side mission on the map. They show as blue and purple icons: Yaoguai Portals, Energy Sources and side missions such as Jiangshi Park and Jiangshi Garage.

achievements.summary: Earn gold on 5 Nightmare in North Point stat awards.

guide.context: Missions cannot be replayed. If you miss a stat, start a new DLC game; counters are kept. Jiang Shi respawn at Energy Sources. Peachwood Swords show as red icons on the minimap, wear out, and disappear when a mission ends.

steps.text: Vampire Hunter: melee-kill 200 Jiang Shi. Cars do not count. Throw a Jiang Shi into an Energy Source to stop its spawns once you are done.
Demon Hunter: kill 20 Yaoguai.
Demonic Exorcism: kill 15 Yaoguai with a Peachwood Sword.
Hard to Get: counter 100 Jiang Shi bites.
Underworld Offering: locate every one of the 10 Hell Shrines.

achievements.summary: Find all 10 Hell Shrines in Nightmare in North Point.

guide.context: The shrines do not show on the map. A shrine counts toward the Cursed Gold stat Underworld Offering.

collectibles.name: Hell Shrine 1
collectibles.method: Beside three Jiang Shi on the way to Yaoguai Alley.

collectibles.name: Hell Shrine 2
collectibles.method: Walk out of the apartment.

collectibles.name: Hell Shrine 3
collectibles.location: Upper level near the ice cream vendor
collectibles.method: Finish the Jiangshi Court Energy Source, then go up in front of the building.

collectibles.name: Hell Shrine 4
collectibles.method: Go left out of the temple and north, then reach the alley intersection.

collectibles.name: Hell Shrine 5
collectibles.method: Take the tree-lined main road, turn left toward Industrial, and look beside the big road.

collectibles.name: Hell Shrine 6
collectibles.method: Cross the highway, take the alley fork and clear the Jiang Shi guards.

collectibles.name: Hell Shrine 7
collectibles.location: Waterfront, beside a wooden boat on a rack
collectibles.method: Drive south along the sea to where Smiley Cat's Army began.

collectibles.name: Hell Shrine 8
collectibles.location: South seaside, before a square road
collectibles.method: Pass the bridge-style road, turn left twice, and the shrine is on your right.

collectibles.name: Hell Shrine 9
collectibles.method: Turn left at the sign for Northpoint Park and clear the Jiang Shi guarding it.

collectibles.name: Hell Shrine 10
collectibles.method: Drive south from the auto lot, through a narrow alley, to the group of Jiang Shi.

achievements.summary: Finish the first Year of the Snake mission, Bomb Squad.

steps.text: Start the DLC from the main menu and finish @loc{Bomb Squad}, the first mission.

achievements.summary: Defeat the cultists in the Year of the Snake finale.

steps.text: Finish the story to the last mission, @loc{New Year's Eve}, and defeat the cultists.

achievements.description: Complete all secondary content of Year of the Snake.
achievements.sortReason: Year of the Snake secondary content.
achievements.summary: Finish all secondary content in Year of the Snake.

guide.context: Finish them as you go through the story.

steps.text: Finish all 4 Favors and 8 side jobs. On the map they appear as yellow bubbles and light blue badges.
Examples: Plaza Patrol, Public Disturbance, Indecent Behaviour, Protect the Lion Dancers, Delivery Boy, Suspicious Vehicles, Bomb Threats, Transit Security and SDU missions.

achievements.summary: Find all 20 evidence bags in Year of the Snake.

guide.context: Bags show on the minimap only near you. After the story, the last three show on the minimap. If the achievement does not pop with 20, complete other tasks and wait.

collectibles.name: Bag 1
collectibles.location: Beside the first brawl, before the car
collectibles.method: After beating four guys, check the corner of that spot.

collectibles.name: Bag 2
collectibles.location: Top of the middle pyramid-shaped container stack
collectibles.method: Climb the middle stack before investigating the car.

collectibles.name: Bag 3
collectibles.location: Police building, near the corner tower
collectibles.method: Check the area by the tower.

collectibles.name: Bag 4
collectibles.location: Skyscraper corner, after the Public Disturbance arrest
collectibles.method: Go up from the arrest and circle the skyscraper corners.

collectibles.name: Bag 5
collectibles.method: At Indecent Behaviour, follow the pool and bridges into the park.

collectibles.name: Bag 6
collectibles.method: On a sofa inside, before the Illumination mission.

collectibles.name: Bag 7
collectibles.method: After dealing with the guests, go where they came from. Get it before chasing the dealer.

collectibles.name: Bag 8
collectibles.location: Hospital lobby, circular area at the corner
collectibles.method: Before the Bomb Threat mission.

collectibles.name: Bag 9
collectibles.method: Guarded by thugs, east side of the big circular area.

collectibles.name: Bag 10
collectibles.location: Corner with a yellow line, one level up
collectibles.method: Southeast of the Shopping Center mission start.

collectibles.name: Bag 11
collectibles.location: Far left end of the fish market
collectibles.method: Take it before going right to the clues.

collectibles.name: Bag 12
collectibles.method: While searching for the lucky money.

collectibles.name: Bag 13
collectibles.method: Before starting the mission.

collectibles.name: Bag 14
collectibles.location: Pool edge, 2-3 levels up from the cemetery
collectibles.method: After the cultists, leave through the cemetery side.

collectibles.name: Bag 15
collectibles.method: On the ledge looking over the Peak Tram track.

collectibles.name: Bag 16
collectibles.location: Dock, second floor with red lights
collectibles.method: Near the middle of the three docks situations.

collectibles.name: Bag 17
collectibles.location: Below the cult area at New Year's Eve
collectibles.method: Behind a shipping container with a railing, after the first wave of cultists. Take it before the cult master.

collectibles.name: Bag 18
collectibles.location: Central home lobby, behind the stairs
collectibles.method: Shows on the minimap after the story ends.

collectibles.name: Bag 19
collectibles.method: In front of one set of elevators.

collectibles.name: Bag 20
collectibles.method: On the second floor.
